verses.text: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
lines: I will exalt you, my God, the King.
I will praise your name forever and ever.

verses.text: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
lines: Every day I will praise you.
I will extol your name forever and ever.

verses.text: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
lines: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised!
His greatness is unsearchable.

verses.text: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
lines: One generation will commend your works to another,
and will declare your mighty acts.

verses.text: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
lines: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor,
on your wondrous works.

verses.text: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.
lines: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts.
I will declare your greatness.

verses.text: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
lines: They will utter the memory of your great goodness,
and will sing of your righteousness.

verses.text: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
lines: Yahweh is gracious, merciful,
slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

verses.text: Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
lines: Yahweh is good to all.
His tender mercies are over all his works.

verses.text: All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.
lines: All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh.
Your saints will extol you.

verses.text: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,
lines: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom,
and talk about your power,

verses.text: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
lines: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts,
the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

verses.text: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. Yahweh is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
lines: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom.
Your dominion endures throughout all generations.
Yahweh is faithful in all his words,
and loving in all his deeds.

verses.text: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
lines: Yahweh upholds all who fall,
and raises up all those who are bowed down.

verses.text: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
lines: The eyes of all wait for you.
You give them their food in due season.

verses.text: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
lines: You open your hand,
and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

verses.text: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
lines: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways,
and gracious in all his works.

verses.text: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
lines: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him,
to all who call on him in truth.

verses.text: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
lines: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him.
He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

verses.text: Yahweh preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.
lines: Yahweh preserves all those who love him,
but he will destroy all the wicked.

verses.text: My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
lines: My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh.
Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
